workflow.action: Execute the transfers on the clock
workflow.description: Wet, fast, one-direction transfers through the rinse gates with delays routed to holding rinse and reactivation
workflow.artifact: executed transfer sequence with gate readings
workflow.gate: every conductivity gate passed and every delay logged with its reactivation

workflow.description: Withdraw slowly, dwell and tilt over the tank, first rinse into the recovery stream
workflow.gate: slow withdrawal, dwell performed, first rinse into the labeled recovery vessel

workflow.description: Cascade to a DI final, dry without rubbing, flush and extend drying for hollows, remove masks with inspection
workflow.gate: no spots, no residue on wearables, masks removed clean, hollows verified dry

workflow.action: Unrack, inspect contacts and hand off
workflow.description: Glove-handled unracking over a soft surface with contact-mark inspection against the plan and soft-packed release to quality
workflow.gate: marks inside planned zones or routed to touch-up; no handling damage; contact map accompanies the lot

workflow.description: Verify every planned field was recorded during the run and exceptions carry their responses
workflow.gate: the job is reconstructable from the log alone - route, fixture, baths, tank order, electrical column, gates, exceptions, operator, timestamps

dominance_rules.rule: The cyanide-acid segregation line dominates every handling, routing and plumbing choice
dominance_rules.rationale: acid contact with cyanide solutions generates hydrogen cyanide; no schedule or convenience justifies the exposure
dominance_rules.trigger: any decision that would let acid-line and cyanide-line chemistry, rinses, vessels, drains or travel paths meet
dominance_rules.action: block the choice, separate physically, and route the question to formal training and jurisdiction rules

dominance_rules.rule: Escalation dominates schedule on any piece that cannot be held without unsanctioned damage
dominance_rules.rationale: fixture damage to a customer piece is irreversible; a lost day is not
dominance_rules.trigger: the contact plan exhausts its fallbacks or any candidate grip risks the piece
dominance_rules.action: stop, document the options considered, and send the piece to intake and the customer decision path

dominance_rules.rationale: a starving or heating contact ruins the deposit around it, which is worse than any planned mark
dominance_rules.trigger: no hidden point can carry the planned current without heating or intermittence
dominance_rules.action: use a mid-run contact move or planned touch-up zone; if neither serves, escalate - never run the starving contact

dominance_rules.rationale: a tangled, bruised or dented lot costs more than the racking labor the barrel would have saved
dominance_rules.trigger: batch-size pressure argues for bulking pieces the route mechanism excludes
dominance_rules.action: split the batch or rack the excluded pieces; under-filled runs go to the business side as a pricing fact

dominance_rules.rule: A failed rinse gate dominates line speed
dominance_rules.rationale: drag-in that reaches the gold bath converts one late batch into a contaminated tank
dominance_rules.trigger: a conductivity gate reads above its threshold at a critical entry
dominance_rules.action: stop the transfer, refresh or diagnose the rinse, and pass the gate before the work advances

dominance_rules.rule: Equipment-manufacturer instructions dominate improvisation on fixtures, barrels and agitation hardware
dominance_rules.rationale: improvised rigging fails unpredictably and voids the safety basis the instructions define
dominance_rules.trigger: a rigging, rotation, load-fraction or splice choice outside the documented instructions
dominance_rules.action: stay within the instructions or send the requirement to a qualified technician

dominance_rules.rule: Recovery routing dominates drain convenience for every gold-bearing stream
dominance_rules.rationale: gold-bearing rinses and aliquots are both regulated-class material and money; drains take both away
dominance_rules.trigger: a gold-bearing rinse, dead-rinse charge or spent aliquot is about to leave the recovery path
dominance_rules.action: route to the labeled reclaim stream and verify the handling class against jurisdiction rules

dominance_rules.rule: The transfer clock dominates drain dwell over perishable surfaces, and dwell dominates at the gold exit
dominance_rules.rationale: activated surfaces die in air in a minutes-class window while the noble gold deposit can wait over its own tank
dominance_rules.trigger: the operator holds a load between tanks deciding whether to drain or move
dominance_rules.action: move perishable surfaces now and let the dead rinse catch the loss; dwell and tilt at the gold exit

dominance_rules.rationale: a reconstructed log is a story, and stories cannot diagnose defects or defend claims
dominance_rules.trigger: any pressure to defer recording until the run is finished
dominance_rules.action: record at the station as events happen, using the wet-hands log design

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the contact plan before any piece is racked
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering contact marks on display faces at unracking and stripping the lot for a replate

anti_rework_rules.rule: Certify rack continuity and coating before loading, every run
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a whole load plated thin against an uncounted breach and run again at the shop's cost

anti_rework_rules.rule: Decide the route before prep is scheduled
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-prepping pieces whose handling class changed when the route call finally happened

anti_rework_rules.rule: Close the batch area list before amps are computed and refuse late additions
anti_rework_rules.prevents: one added piece thinning the whole load below spec and forcing a second run

anti_rework_rules.rule: Coupon-test every mask product against the full tank sequence before production use
anti_rework_rules.prevents: mid-sequence mask lift that bleeds boundaries and sends two-tone work back to strip

anti_rework_rules.rule: Stage and verify the receiving tank before lifting the load from the previous one
anti_rework_rules.prevents: activated surfaces stranded in air, the peel failures that follow, and the re-prep they force

anti_rework_rules.rule: Apply venting and drainage tilts at racking, not after the first bald spot
anti_rework_rules.prevents: gas-pocket voids and crevice-bleed stains that each cost a strip and rerun

anti_rework_rules.rule: Put a refresh threshold on the dead rinse the day it is plumbed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: the recovery rinse quietly becoming a contamination source that poisons the gold bath

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the electrical column and gate readings at the station during the run
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an undiagnosable defect and an unbackable claim when the job is questioned weeks later

iteration_protocol.trigger: unrack inspection finds contact marks outside planned zones
iteration_protocol.action: trace the shift (loose hook, clip creep, plan error), fix the hold or the plan, and update the contact plan for the piece class

iteration_protocol.trigger: recurring bald spots, tide lines or crevice stains on a piece class
iteration_protocol.action: revise the venting and drainage orientation for that class and re-test on the next run

iteration_protocol.trigger: gold-bath analysis or gate readings show drag-in contamination climbing
iteration_protocol.action: audit the rinse sequence, dead-rinse refresh threshold and dwell discipline, and correct the failing stage

iteration_protocol.trigger: a barrel lot shows patchy coverage or bruising complaints
iteration_protocol.action: check load fraction and dangler condition against equipment instructions and revisit whether the lot belonged in the barrel at all

iteration_protocol.trigger: fixture-linked defects recur inside the current maintenance cadence
iteration_protocol.action: shorten the cadence for that fixture class or retire the fixture, using the log's fixture history

iteration_protocol.trigger: the reclaim assay shows drag-out losses rising
iteration_protocol.action: retune withdrawal speed, dwell and tilt practice, and check for new piece classes holding solution

iteration_protocol.trigger: a defect investigation stalls because the run log lacks a field
iteration_protocol.action: add the field to the log design and to the plan template so the gap closes for every future run

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new chemistry, fixture class or layout change enters the shop
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the segregation map, rinse identities, route fitness table and handling obligations before first use

priority_rationale: The frame nodes - run plan, handling obligations, batch strategy - come first because every physical choice hangs off a written plan bounded by safety; the route decision and its three execution classes must precede fixturing detail because contacts, spacing and venting only mean anything on a chosen route; drag-out, rinse design, the transfer clock and the segregation line form the between-tanks discipline that protects both the gold bath and the operator; the close-out pair delivers what the tanks made; and the governance nodes - log, fixture lifecycle, escalation - run across everything because the log is what turns runs into evidence and the escalation boundary is what keeps irreversible damage off the bench.
